interrupted_found: {count} operation(s) from a previous session were interrupted. See Operation History.
mode_dry_run: Dry run is on: no changes are applied
mode_live: Live mode: confirmed changes are applied
windows_only_body: This section is available on Windows 10/11.
dry_run_notice: Dry run is on: the operation will only be planned and recorded; nothing on your computer will change. Turn off dry run in Settings to apply it.
subtitle_dashboard: Keep track of your computer's overall state.
subtitle_cleaner: Review temporary files and move the ones you select to the Recycle Bin.
subtitle_startup: View, enable or disable items that start with Windows.
subtitle_processes: View running processes and resource usage.
subtitle_registry: Inspect and back up registry keys.
subtitle_services: View service status; start or stop the safe ones.
subtitle_disks: Drive usage and physical disk health.
subtitle_diagnostics: Health checks and the Windows event log.
subtitle_history: Every operation the application performed or attempted.
quick_overview_body: Every operation that changes the system is shown first, needs your confirmation, is backed up when needed and is recorded in Operation History. While dry run is on, no changes are applied.
health_disk_low: Drive {drive} is low on free space ({percent}% free).
health_uptime_long: The computer has not been restarted for {days} days; a restart is recommended for updates.
process_read_only: View only: processes are not terminated.
startup_info: Entries are never deleted. Like Windows Task Manager, they are only enabled or disabled; the related registry key is backed up before each change. 'All users' entries require administrator rights.
startup_confirm:
The following will be done for '{name}': {action}.

Continue?
cleaner_info_body: Only files older than {hours} hours in the user's temporary folders are listed. Windows folders, symbolic links and redirected folders are excluded. Selected files are not permanently deleted; they are moved to the Recycle Bin, and files in use are skipped.
scan_failed: An error occurred during analysis. Details were written to the log file.
cleaner_confirm:
{count} files ({size}) will be moved to the Recycle Bin.

Continue?
registry_info: Read-only viewer. No registry values are deleted; you can back up the selected key and restore it later from the Backup page. Double-click to open a subkey.
registry_open_failed: The key could not be opened: {error}
registry_backup_need_path: A whole root hive cannot be backed up. Please enter a subkey path.
disk_physical_info: Health status comes from the Windows Storage API (based on the disk's SMART data).
disk_physical_unavailable: Physical disk information could not be read.
backup_info: Backups are stored as registry export (.reg) files with SHA-256 digests. Integrity is verified before a restore, and the current state is backed up first.
backup_verify_ok: The backup file is intact: the SHA-256 digest matches.
backup_verify_failed: The backup file is missing or modified: the SHA-256 digest does not match.
events_none: No events found in the selected range.
history_description: Every operation is recorded with a unique ID. Select a row to see its details.
history_read_error: The log file could not be read: {error}
op_partial: The operation partially completed: {succeeded} succeeded, {failed} failed (files in use are skipped).
op_failed: The operation could not be completed.
op_dry_run: Dry run: no changes were made. The plan was recorded in Operation History.
op_needs_admin: This operation requires administrator rights. Restart the application as administrator from the Settings page.
op_validation_failed: The safety check blocked the operation. Items outside the allowed scope:
op_backup_failed: The operation was not applied because a backup could not be created.
settings_show_user: Show user names in the process list
settings_dry_run_note: While on, cleanup, startup and restore operations are only planned and recorded; nothing on the computer changes. Creating backups is not affected by this setting.
settings_temp_age: Clean only files at least this old:
settings_admin_yes: The application is running with administrator rights.
settings_admin_no: The application is running with standard user rights.
settings_admin_note: Administrator rights are only needed for 'All users' startup entries and for restoring HKLM backups.
settings_admin_failed: Administrator rights could not be obtained or the request was cancelled.
about_body: Version {version}. A local, offline maintenance and management tool for Windows 10/11. There is no internet connection, telemetry or account system; all data stays on this computer.
subtitle_maintenance: Scheduled system analysis (optional, off by default)
maint_explain: Automatic maintenance only analyses: it does not delete files or change the registry or settings. You are notified of the result the next time you open the app. This feature is off by default.
maint_note_logon: The task is registered in Windows Task Scheduler under your account without administrator rights. It runs only while you are signed in and on AC power; a missed run happens at the next opportunity.
maint_level_critical: Overall: some problems need attention now
maint_status_missing: Turned on, but the scheduled task was not found. Press "Apply" to register it again.
maint_status_leftover: Off, but an old scheduled task remains. Press "Apply" to remove it.
maint_no_report: No maintenance report yet. Use "Analyse now" to create one.
maint_report_meta: {time} ({trigger}) · Junk files: {files} ({size}) · Enabled startup programs: {startup} · Error events in the last 24 hours: {events}
maint_running: Analysing; this can take about a minute...
maint_confirm_enable: Automatic maintenance will be registered in Windows Task Scheduler. The task only analyses and never deletes or changes anything. Continue?
maint_confirm_disable: Automatic maintenance will be turned off and the scheduled task deleted. Continue?
maint_disk_unhealthy: Physical disk does not look healthy: {name}. Back up your data.
maint_junk_large: Junk files take up {size}. You can review them on the Junk File Cleanup page.
maint_startup_many: {count} startup programs are enabled; this can slow down start-up.
maint_events_many: {count} error events were logged in the last 24 hours. See the System Diagnostics page.
maint_new_report: A new automatic maintenance report is ready ({count} findings). See the Automatic Maintenance page.
uninstall_explain: If you installed with the setup file, uninstall from Windows Settings → Apps; the maintenance task and shortcuts are removed too. If you use the portable folder version, press this button first, then delete the folders yourself.
uninstall_confirm: The automatic maintenance task (if any) will be deleted and the feature turned off. Continue?
uninstall_steps:
Preparation complete. To uninstall:

1. Close WinCare Manager.
2. Delete the program folder (the folder containing WinCare Manager.exe).
3. To also delete your settings, history and backups, delete this folder:
{data}

Note: before deleting backups, make sure there is no change you want to undo.
services_control_note: Critical Windows and security services cannot be stopped. Services that other running services depend on are not stopped either. The start type is never changed. Starting and stopping require administrator rights; nothing changes in dry run mode.
service_select_first: Select a service from the list first.
service_confirm_start: The "{name}" service will be started. Continue?
service_confirm_stop: The "{name}" service will be stopped. Programs that use it may not work correctly. The service starts again after a restart according to its start type. Continue?
service_protected: "{name}" is a critical Windows service and cannot be stopped.
service_has_dependents: Other running services depend on "{name}"; it was not stopped to avoid a chain of stops.
service_dependents_unknown: Services depending on "{name}" could not be read; it was not stopped for safety.
service_disabled: "{name}" is disabled and cannot be started.
service_wrong_state: "{name}" is not in the right state for this action. Refresh the list and try again.
